channel.description: Latest articles from The Valley Times-News (valleytimes-news.com)

item.title: CONTRIBUTOR'S VIEW - John Tures: Five Questions To Ask Ourselves About The War With Iran
item.description: Political scientist John Tures outlines five urgent questions Americans should ask about the war with Iran, from strategy and allies to Congress’ role and long-term goals.

item.title: Valley Parks and Rec hosts Easter egg hunt
item.description: Valley Parks and Recreation will host a free Easter egg hunt April 4, 10–11:30 a.m., at Shawmut Airport for ages 0–15, with prizes, vendors and photos with the Easter Bunny.

item.title: CONTRIBUTOR'S VIEW - L. Michelle Moore: A New Pledge to Bring Down Power Bills
item.description: Tech giants join Trump’s Ratepayer Protection Pledge, vowing to fund data-center power infrastructure while states like Alabama and Georgia test ways to cut household bills.

item.title: Oak Bowery VFD celebrates Easter, kicks off station campaign
item.description: Oak Bowery VFD will hold its first free Community Egg Hunt on March 29 with games, food and photos, while launching a campaign for a new fire station and community gathering space.

item.title: Local farmers win division in Outstanding Young Farm Family Contest
item.description: Christopher and Hannah Langley of Camp Hill were named Forestry Division winners in Alabama’s Outstanding Young Farm Family contest and will serve on the State Forestry Committee.

item.title: What Happens to Civil Court Cases When a Defendant Is on Active Duty?
item.description: When someone is sued in civil court, the process typically follows a set timeline with mailed notices, scheduled hearings, and required responses.

item.title: How TikTok Metrics Influence Local Event Attendance and Community Support
item.description: TikTok is now more than a place for dances and fun videos.

item.title: The Digital Footprint: How Premium TikTok Likes Are Helping Local Businesses Go Viral
item.description: All activities undertaken by a business in the internet world leave a trace that is measurable.

item.title: West Point FD discusses Project Lifesaver program
item.description: West Point Fire Chief Derick Staley explained how Project Lifesaver has helped local responders locate missing residents with dementia, autism and other cognitive conditions.

item.title: Free community distribution set for March 13
item.description: Free food, clothing, shoes and household items will be distributed March 13, 10–11 a.m., at 1239 OG Skinner Dr. in West Point for individuals and families facing economic hardship.
